label: café queue
ground: Changing the queue changes what the on-call rota runs, which is the owner's to decide.
question: Which queue should carry the "retry" jobs?
problem: Both queues meet the throughput target; neither is clearly better for jobs that retry.
context: Retry jobs run from the café-region workers and today share the main queue.

options.reason: Keeps one queue to watch; retries already back off, so they don't starve new jobs.
options.label: Main queue
A "retry" queue
options.reason: Isolates retries so a retry storm can't delay new work, at the cost of a second queue to watch.
